description: Verify Wave0 produced minimum shared foundation evidence: reference index exists, per-topic reference metadata files exist and pass ReferenceMetadata schema validation, metadata count meets foundation floor per topic, trace evidence present, status values point to wave0→wave1.

rules.failure_message: Missing file: reference/index.md. Write an index summarizing the foundation reference collection for each topic.
Missing directory: reference/. Create the directory and add per-topic reference metadata.
Missing per-topic reference metadata: reference/{topic}/source.yaml. Search and collect at least foundation floor count of references for each topic in the topic_registry.
Reference metadata in reference/{topic}/source.yaml fails schema validation. Each entry must have url, title, retrieved_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and topic_tag.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference metadata entries. Collect at least the foundation floor count for each topic.
Missing trace event: wave0_completion. The phase body requires recording this event in rb_trace.jsonl before running the gate.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'wave0_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave1_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
